text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her illness, Super Creek<n>races in the
Japanese Derby, where<n>she miraculously pulls
through and<n>nabs first place.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I explain how I worked hard so that<n>she could win.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She then praises me with the ultimate<n>compliment.
